text.description_html:
DWD-P5240US3, Ornate Grand Palais Polished Brass Push Plate

Grand Palais Push Plate is about as ornate as a push plate can get. Its regal detailing makes it perfect for the great palace of Paris, the doors of some of the top luxury hotels in the world, and even your home. Made out of cast brass, this door push plate is 25-1/2 inches tall and 3-5/8 inches wide, so you can be sure that it will make a grand statement on any door. Bring the glory of the ornamented to your home with the Polished Brass Grand Palais Door Push Plate and make sure to complete the look the matching Grand Palais Pull Plate. Assembled and finished in the USA, it comes complete with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.

Also available: Matching Grand Palais Pull Plate

Features and Specifications for the Ornate Grand Palais Pull Plate:

  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Material: Cast Brass
  • Plate Width: 3-5/8"
  • Plate Height: 25-1/2"
  • Comes complete with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.
  • Hand rubbed and finished in the USA with a 10 year warranty.

Sold Individually
